Privacy Policy

This page explains what information the {{company.name}} website ({{site.baseUrl}}) handles, how advertising works here, and how to contact us. Last updated: 14 November 2026.

What we collect

This website has no user accounts and does not ask you to sign in. If you use a contact button, your phone or e-mail app opens with a message addressed to us: we receive only what you choose to send. We use your message to answer you and do not sell it.

Advertising and cookies

We use Google AdSense to show ads on some pages. Google and its partners use cookies and similar technologies to show ads based on your visits to this and other websites, to measure ads and to prevent fraud. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visit to our site and other sites on the internet.

You can manage or switch off personalised ads in Google Ads Settings, or learn more at How Google uses data in advertising. You can also visit aboutads.info to opt out of some third-party vendors' use of cookies. Where the law requires it (for example in the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom), a consent message asks for your choice before personalised ads are shown.

Other services

Pages may load fonts, images and scripts from content delivery services. These services can see your IP address and browser details when they deliver the file, as with any website.

Children

This website is not directed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their information.

Your choices

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, use a private window, or install an ad blocker. Some parts of the site may look different without cookies.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version is published on this page with a new date.

Contact

Questions about this policy: {{company.contact.email}}.
